rule: Kept if profitable in CFB, NFL or UFC (at least 20 graded picks), or across the three combined. Analysts not listed (no record found) are left off.
notes: Action Network: each expert's all-time tracked record per league from their AN profile (units net; includes props). Ryan Minion's all-time AN numbers are corrupted (+100,128u NFL), so his 2026-season numbers are used. SportsLine: every graded pick SportsLine lists (NFL and CFB since 2016, UFC since May 2026), units won at the posted price (1 unit risked, -110 if no price). Records are [W, L, P, units].

nflprop.rule: NFL player props: kept if up in units on at least 50 graded NFL prop picks (records through 2026-wk10).

nflml.rule: NFL moneylines: kept if up in units on at least 50 graded NFL moneyline picks (records through 2026-11-27).

cfb.rule: College football: kept if up in units on at least 50 graded CFB picks (records through 2026-11-27).
